text: You're looking for a delicious and healthy salad recipe that fits your lower sodium goal, and this Caribbean Fruity Chicken Salad is a great choice. The combination of protein-rich chicken, fresh fruits like bananas and pineapple, and crunchy cashews will keep you full and satisfied. Plus, the recipe is quick to prepare, taking only about 15 minutes, which fits within your 45-minute time budget. With only 132mg of sodium per serving, you can enjoy this dish without worrying about exceeding your daily limit.
